crossRefs.note: Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.
“Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
“Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.
He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and…
But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in…
Lift up your eyes, and see those who come from the north. Where is the flock that was given to you, your beautiful…
“Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!” says Yahweh.
“Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy, and tell them, even the shepherds, ‘The Lord Yahweh…
You eat the fat. You clothe yourself with the wool. You kill the fatlings, but you don’t feed the sheep.
Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword will be on his arm, and on his right eye. His arm will be…

translations.web: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
translations.bsb: I know that after my departure, savage wolves will come in among you and will not spare the flock.
translations.kjv: For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
translations.asv: I know that after my departing grievous wolves shall enter in among you, not sparing the flock;
